# proxmox_cluster_ceph_flag (Resource)

Toggles one Ceph cluster flag through `PUT /cluster/ceph/flags/{flag}`. Destroy disables the flag again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_ceph_flag" "noout" {
  flag    = "noout"
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the flag is set.
- `flag` (String) Flag: `nobackfill`, `nodeep-scrub`, `nodown`, `noin`, `noout`, `norebalance`, `norecover`, `noscrub`, `notieragent`, `noup` or `pause`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Flag name.
